name: Musume x Musume Swapping ~Aitsu no Musume to Yaru Kawari ni, Boku wa Waga Musume o Sashidasu~

source:

We were completely different in terms of personality and circumstances, but we shared the same fetish for swapping.

"Hey...Masashi. Wanna try it again for the first time in a while?"

Surely, we seduce each other's wife, but I couldn't imagine being excited by someone past their prime.

But, we didn't have any young women around here...?! 

At that moment, the worst and most exciting idea popped into to my head.

"Yeah, we both have someone, don't we?...Our precious only daughters."

Our understanding was perfect. We both had daughters, and we were considering offering them as swapping partners.
